ND1: Removed an unsupported causal claim about separating sensor drift from environmental change. The contribution is a matched-budget sequential comparison, not the invention of reference-efficient calibration.
ND5: Unseen-location evaluation requires shared node-wise scoring or scenario inference. Fixed multiclass trees are restricted to held-out episodes at known locations.
ND7: Missing recorded lead channels are distinct from physical electrode failures; the example and simulated-missingness claim now preserve that distinction.
ND10: Visible words prevent isolated inner-speech identification. The study is a cued-task classification/artifact audit; no causal fraction of thought decoding is claimed.
LE1: Natural held-out signature prevalence must be preserved; only training negatives may be capped or resampled.
LE2: Boundary uncertainty and plausible class sets must be computed from coarsened training labels only. Clean masks cannot silently provide privileged training supervision.
